summary: Omaha is a vibrant Midwestern city known for its excellent food scene, rich history, and stunning views of the Missouri River. Home to world-class attractions like the Henry Doorly Zoo and the Creighton Prep campus, Omaha offers visitors an authentic American heartland experience with surprising cultural depth and culinary innovation.

activities.name: Henry Doorly Zoo & Aquarium
activities.description: One of the world's best zoos featuring over 17,000 animals, an indoor rainforest dome, and a massive aquarium with shark lagoon.

activities.name: Old Market Walking Tour
activities.description: Explore historic cobblestone streets lined with galleries, shops, and restaurants in Omaha's most charming neighborhood.

activities.name: Durham Museum
activities.description: Housed in a restored 1931 railway station, this museum showcases Omaha's history with exhibits on Native Americans, frontier life, and local heritage.

activities.name: Heartland of America Park
activities.description: Beautiful urban park featuring a scenic lake, fountains, walking paths, and panoramic views of the Missouri River.

activities.name: Lauritzen Gardens
activities.description: Stunning 160-acre botanical garden with themed gardens, walking trails, and seasonal flower displays along the Missouri River.

activities.name: Joslyn Art Museum
activities.description: Free-admission art museum housed in a stunning Art Deco building with extensive collections spanning Egyptian antiquities to contemporary works.

activities.name: Creighton University Campus Tour
activities.description: Historic Jesuit university campus featuring beautiful Gothic Revival architecture and significant educational landmarks.

activities.name: Missouri River Activities
activities.description: Kayaking, paddleboarding, and riverboat cruises offering scenic views and outdoor recreation on the iconic river.

activities.name: Papillion-La Vista South High School Aquatics Center
activities.description: State-of-the-art aquatics facility with slides, pools, and family-friendly water attractions.

activities.name: Omaha Nightlife & Entertainment
activities.description: Vibrant bar scene with live music venues, comedy clubs, and craft cocktail bars concentrated in the Old Market and midtown.

activities.name: Gene Leahy Mall
activities.description: Scenic walking and biking path along the Missouri River connecting major parks and attractions.

activities.name: College World Series Baseball
activities.description: NCAA Division I baseball tournament held annually at TD Ameritrade Park, a world-class baseball stadium.

lensRecommendations: 16-35mm wide-angle for architectural sweeps and landscape vistas of the Missouri River
50mm prime for street photography in the Old Market and neighborhood character shots
70-200mm telephoto for compressing distant cityscape elements and wildlife at the zoo
Macro lens for garden details and close-up botanical photography at Lauritzen Gardens
photography.goldenHourNotes: Omaha's best light occurs during golden hour when warm tones illuminate the brick buildings of the Old Market and reflect beautifully off the Missouri River. The Bob Kerrey Bridge is particularly stunning at sunrise with the city skyline emerging from shadow. Summer evenings offer extended golden hour opportunities due to later sunsets around 9 PM.

weather.seasonality: Omaha experiences four distinct seasons with hot, humid summers and cold winters. Spring and early fall offer the most pleasant weather for outdoor activities and sightseeing.
weather.summary: Omaha's climate is characterized by continental weather patterns with warm summers averaging 26-28°C and cold winters dropping below freezing. The city experiences moderate rainfall year-round with peaks in spring and early summer.
